theorems.name: Submission.br_loc_triple_inter_open
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U U' V M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → IsOpen V → M ∩ V ⊆ U' → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U' → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ V ∩ K) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) → IsRectifiableTriple U' n (M ∩ V) θ ξ
